REQUESTS ARE SLOW.

Why p95 and not average: an average hides the tail. If 90% of requests take 10ms and 10% take 5s, the average looks fine and one user in ten is having a terrible time.

First command:
  kubectl top pods -n orders

Investigation:
  1. CPU near the limit? -> the container is being THROTTLED. CPU is compressible:
     it does not kill the container, it just makes everything slow until upstream
     timeouts convert slowness into 5xx.
  2. Is a dependency slow?
       kubectl logs -n orders -l app.kubernetes.io/instance=orders-api \n         | jq -c 'select(.latency_ms > 1000)'
  3. Did latency change at a deploy?  helm history orders-api -n orders
  4. Is the HPA scaling?  kubectl get hpa -n orders

A new version that is 3x slower is a FAILED deploy even if it returns 200.
